question: On ESP32 chip revision v3.1, can GPIO4 use a rising-edge interrupt while other GPIO0-31 pins also have interrupts enabled? If not, what level-triggered workaround does the errata describe?

generation.answer: On ESP32 chip revision v3.1, GPIO4 cannot use a rising-edge interrupt while other GPIO0-31 pins also have interrupts enabled due to the limitation described in [GPIO-3.14] on Page 18. The errata describes a workaround: set the GPIO interrupt type to high for the desired GPIO pin before triggering the interrupt, then change it to low after the CPU services the interrupt. This ensures that the CPU ignores the interrupt service routine during the second interrupt, allowing the desired GPIO interrupt to be triggered on a rising edge.
